featured_reviews.review_text: I joined ArtVilla 5 months ago for their pottery course and it’s been such a fun experience! featured_reviews.name: Trupti Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our birthday in the most creative and memorable way this year—with a pottery workshop! It was such a unique and wholesome experience, surrounded by friends, clay, and lots of laughter.

From the moment we arrived, the space felt welcoming and calming. The instructors were patient, encouraging, and made sure even the beginners felt confident while working on the wheel or hand-building pieces. We got to explore our creativity, get our hands dirty, and make something special with our own hands—a refreshing break from the usual birthday routines.

What made it even more special was how personal and peaceful the experience felt. Time flew by as we shaped, smoothed, and experimented with different forms. Everyone left with their own little masterpiece and a big smile.

Highly recommend this for anyone looking for a meaningful, hands-on activity to celebrate any occasion—or even just to try something new!

A special thanks to my instructor, Pooja, who guided and supported me throughout. She was always patient, encouraging, and extremely helpful in improving my pottery skills. I learned a lot and truly enjoyed every class. Highly recommended for anyone interested in pottery and ceramics!

featured_reviews.name: Alok Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently attended a pottery session at ArtVilla Academy, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience! I went along with my wife, mother, and mother-in-law, and each one of us had a great time. For most of us, it was our first time trying pottery, but the team made sure we felt comfortable and guided us patiently throughout the session.

The highlight of our visit was creating our very own custom-designed pots and a beautiful vase — something we were genuinely proud of by the end. The staff was incredibly helpful, attentive, and encouraging, which really made the session both fun and relaxing.

The academy itself is well-maintained, with clean and spacious classrooms, creating a calming and creative atmosphere. Apart from pottery, ArtVilla Academy also offers a variety of other creative activities like painting, which we’re now curious to try in the future!

A special mention to the founder, who was very warm and friendly — you can really feel the passion they’ve put into building this space for learning and art.

If you're looking for a creative, hands-on experience in a friendly and supportive environment, I would highly recommend trying out the pottery sessions at ArtVilla Academy. It’s perfect for all age groups and a great way to spend quality time with family or friends while learning something new!
